name: io.github.hyperdrift-io/deputy-workforce-mcp
description: Read-only Deputy coverage, workload, timesheet, availability, and staffing signals.

environmentVariables.name: DEPUTY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Use fixture for fictional evaluation data or live for a Deputy installation.

environmentVariables.name: DEPUTY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Customer-specific Deputy installation URL; required in live mode.

environmentVariables.name: DEPUTY_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Customer-owned Deputy OAuth access token; required in live mode.

environmentVariables.name: DEPUTY_AUTH_SCHEME
environmentVariables.description: Authorization scheme for the issued Deputy token.
